note: Hosts that cost a run its window, with what they actually do. Written because this knowledge existed in data/research/ two days before a pass died on it twice: a research file nobody reads at the moment it matters is not a record, it is a souvenir. Every brief must carry this list, and scripts/passcheck.py prints it.
rule: Every fetch gets a hard timeout: curl -m 20, or timeout= on urllib. A host that hangs once goes on this list with the date. A hang is far worse than a refusal, because a refusal fails in a second and a hang burns the whole window.

gemeentebestuur.haarlem.nl.behaviour: does not hang, but serves an Anubis bot-challenge HTML page (200 OK, ~6.6KB) instead of the requested PDF to plain curl, even with a browser user agent
gemeentebestuur.haarlem.nl.cost: cheap, fails in under a second, but wastes a fetch if not expected
gemeentebestuur.haarlem.nl.workaround: unknown; a real browser session may pass the challenge. www.bomenstichting.nl and www.ivn.nl serve their own monumental-trees PDFs for Haarlem and both downloaded fine via plain curl, so prefer those over the gemeente's own hosted copy

rijksmonumenten.nl.behaviour: hangs / socket hang up on individual monument pages (both via WebFetch and via curl -m 20 with a browser user agent, curl exit 92)
rijksmonumenten.nl.cost: burned two attempts during a Nijmegen deepen verify pass, zero content returned either time
rijksmonumenten.nl.workaround: unknown; WebSearch's own extracted snippets exist for this content but per the search-summary-is-a-lead-never-a-source rule they could not be used to verify a specific tree claim without seeing the page itself

ateneodecordoba.com.behaviour: hangs, no response at all (curl -m 20 exit 28, both http and https)
ateneodecordoba.com.cost: burned two 20s timeouts during a Cordoba deepen verify pass
ateneodecordoba.com.workaround: unknown; used WebSearch snippet-level results instead of a direct fetch

www.lapresse.ca.behaviour: 405 Method Not Allowed to plain curl (GET), fast fail, not a hang
www.lapresse.ca.cost: cheap, failed in under a second
www.lapresse.ca.workaround: Wayback Machine snapshot worked fine via curl (no browser UA needed): http://web.archive.org/web/<timestamp>/<url>, use the archive.org/wayback/available API to find the closest snapshot first

www.alsace.eu.symptom: hangs, no response at all (curl -m 20 exit 28, ECONNREFUSED/timeout on both the specific page and the bare domain root); burned the full 20s timeout twice during a Bordeaux/Strasbourg verify pass
www.alsace.eu.workaround: unknown; the Collectivite europeenne d'Alsace's own remarkable-trees register (arbre-368, Platane du Parc du Contades) was cited via WebSearch's own extracted snippet instead of a direct fetch

cultural.valencia.es.cost: two Valencia passes died on it, nothing written either time
cultural.valencia.es.workaround: unknown; try valencia.es (302, responds fine) or the Generalitat catalogue instead

www.sevilla.org.cost: a Seville pass lost time before finding the mirror
www.sevilla.org.workaround: www.femas.es serves the identical municipal PDF

diario.madrid.es.workaround: none found; open in a browser session or skip

barcelona.cat.workaround: the register is already imported at data/registers/barcelona-ail.json

publico.pt.workaround: none needed, it is a newspaper and a lead rather than a source

sites.heritage.brussels.behaviour: 403 to WebFetch, 200 to curl with a browser user agent

comune.milano.it.workaround: Regione Lombardia press releases and Il Giorno surveys served as second sources instead

avrupaanitagaclar.com.symptom: COMPROMISED: serves unrelated gambling content; was cited as detail-page host for Turkish register records
avrupaanitagaclar.com.workaround: never fetch or cite; use the national registry itself

www.loc.gov.symptom: Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' challenge to plain curl and to WebFetch on every /pictures/item/ and /item/ path tried (dc1027 through dc1051 range); 403 every time, no browser UA tested
www.loc.gov.workaround: tile.loc.gov (the raw PDF/image storage host, e.g. https://tile.loc.gov/storage-services/master/pnp/habshaer/dc/dc1000/dcNNNN/data/dcNNNNdata.pdf) is NOT behind the same Cloudflare gate and served most HALS survey PDFs fine this pass; note those PDFs are scanned images (JBIG2) with no text layer, so they confirm a record's existence and title but cannot be read for content without OCR

nycgovparks.org.symptom: HTTP 202 with EMPTY body to curl and WebFetch: a soft bot-block that wastes time instead of erroring
nycgovparks.org.workaround: Wayback Machine direct web.archive.org/web/<date>/ URLs (the availability API itself rate-limits)

hmdb.org.symptom: Cloudflare 'Just a moment' challenge to curl and WebFetch
hmdb.org.workaround: Wayback snapshots, as the DC pass used

monumentaltrees.com.symptom: 403 to curl (was fetchable earlier); a browser session gets a Cloudflare 'Just a moment' interstitial first but clears it on its own within about 5 seconds
monumentaltrees.com.workaround: browser session for fact verification only, wait a few seconds after navigating; hard rule 1 forbids content reuse anyway

konusanagac.com.symptom: DNS resolution fails outright (ENOTFOUND / could not resolve host) to both curl and WebFetch; not a block, genuinely unreachable from this sandbox
konusanagac.com.workaround: WebSearch's own page-reading still surfaces usable extracted facts from individual pages (used successfully this pass for Istanbul's Gulhane Park trees, konusanagac.com/ozel-agac/*); a session with different network access may be able to fetch it directly

www.aoc.gov.symptom: 403 to curl (plain and browser UA) and to WebFetch on every /explore-capitol-campus/features/ and /blog/ path tried; not a Cloudflare interstitial, a flat 403
www.aoc.gov.workaround: Wayback Machine snapshots (web.archive.org/web/<date>/https://www.aoc.gov/...) load fine via curl with a browser UA and are recent (May-July 2026 snapshots available); WebFetch itself refuses web.archive.org URLs outright ('unable to fetch'), so use curl + local HTML/text parsing for archive.org fetches, not WebFetch

olmsted.org.symptom: Cloudflare 'Just a moment' / bot-check redirect loop to curl (with or without browser UA)
olmsted.org.workaround: Wayback Machine snapshot worked fine via curl; note its content on the Capitol trees page is explicitly 'republished with permission from the Architect of the Capitol', i.e. NOT an independent source from aoc.gov even though the domain differs

loc.getarchive.net.symptom: 403 to curl even with a browser user agent
loc.getarchive.net.workaround: none found this pass; tile.loc.gov raw PDF storage remains the working route to HALS record content (see www.loc.gov entry)

www.portlandmaps.com.symptom: hangs, no response at all, on the /od/rest/services/... ArcGIS REST path specifically; burned the full 20s timeout twice
www.portlandmaps.com.workaround: the opendata.arcgis.com/datasets/<item>_<layer>.geojson redirect route (lands on hub.arcgis.com/api/download/v1/items/...) reaches the same Heritage Trees data fine

www.up.pt.symptom: hangs: no response at all, burns the full 20s timeout on /jardimbotanico/ (other up.pt subdomains are fine)
www.up.pt.workaround: mhnc.up.pt serves the Jardim Botanico do Porto pages and its /pt/contactos/ page carries the addresses (jardimbotanico@mhnc.up.pt); jardimbotanico.up.pt itself fails fast with a TLS/DNS error, which is cheap rather than harmful

www.cagliaritoday.it.problem: 403 to WebFetch on every URL tried (not a hang)
www.cagliaritoday.it.workaround: curl -m 20 with a browser user agent returns clean 200s, same pattern as monumentaltrees.com and sites.heritage.brussels

bigtrees.forestry.ubc.ca.problem: UBC's IT bot-defense returns a captcha challenge page (200 status, page body is the captcha itself) to plain curl on every path tried, including /terms-of-use/ and /bc-bigtree-registry/champion/. Not a hang, and captchas are never to be solved by an agent.
bigtrees.forestry.ubc.ca.workaround: none found this pass; the BC Big Tree Registry licence and downloadable Excel remain unverified. A session with a real browser (this project's Browser pane, not curl/WebFetch) should be able to clear it; do not attempt to bypass the captcha programmatically.

vilnius.lt.behaviour: 403 Forbidden to both curl and WebFetch on its protected-object register pages. Fast fail, not a hang, so it costs a second rather than a window.
vilnius.lt.cost: one fetch during a Vilnius verify pass; cheap, recorded so the next pass does not try it first
vilnius.lt.workaround: Lithuanian Wikipedia reproduces the municipal protected-object list with register id, address and measurements. Fetch its WIKITEXT and join on the id: that confirmed or killed 8 of 10 candidates in one pass and surfaced two delisted-dead trees the register itself does not flag. Same technique as pl.wikipedia for Krakow and Warsaw.

candelaria.es.behaviour: TLS failure: self-signed certificate. Fast fail.
candelaria.es.cost: one fetch during the Tenerife island pass
candelaria.es.workaround: none found; the Cabildo de Tenerife monumental-tree portal covers the island and OSM natural=tree nodes give the pin

archive.nelsonmandela.org.behaviour: Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' JS challenge to both curl (plain and browser UA) and WebFetch; fast response, not a hang, but no usable content
archive.nelsonmandela.org.cost: cheap, failed in a couple seconds each time, during a Singapore deepen verify pass
archive.nelsonmandela.org.workaround: none found this pass; used WebSearch's own extracted snippets and an independent Flickr photo caption instead for the Mandela/Singapore Botanic Gardens visit fact

allaboutlimassol.com.behaviour: 403 to WebFetch consistently, but curl with a browser user agent returns clean 200s.
allaboutlimassol.com.cost: none, caught on the Cyprus pass

wikiloc.com.behaviour: 403 to WebFetch and to curl with a browser user agent, both attempts.
wikiloc.com.cost: two attempts on the Cyprus pass
wikiloc.com.workaround: its coordinates appear in the search snippet; treat those as approximate and say so

frankfurt.de.behaviour: Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' 403 to both curl (browser user agent included) and WebFetch. Fast fail, not a hang, so it costs a second rather than a window
frankfurt.de.cost: the Frankfurt verify pass could not read the city register directly
frankfurt.de.workaround: de.wikipedia's 'Liste der Naturdenkmale in Frankfurt am Main', fetched as WIKITEXT and joined to the city's own gazette (Amtsblatt Nr. 44/2025), carries the same register content; that join delivered the whole pass. Wayback snapshots of frankfurt.de load, but archive.org's availability API starts 429-ing after roughly 6 to 8 calls

www.nativetreesociety.org.behaviour: connection refused on both 80 and 443, fails fast at about 170 ms rather than hanging
www.nativetreesociety.org.cost: nothing, because it fails fast; recorded so nobody assumes the site is merely slow
www.nativetreesociety.org.workaround: it held precise laser measurements for New Orleans City Park's oaks. Those figures survive in search snippets and on neworleanscitypark.org, which is what this page used.

overpass-api.de.behaviour: NOT down, it rate-limits hard. A burst of is_in queries sent without a User-Agent returned HTTP 406, and after that the host refused connections for the rest of the session and took the overpass.kumi.systems mirror down with it
overpass-api.de.cost: a pin-containment check on 24 New York and Washington trees, abandoned
overpass-api.de.workaround: send a User-Agent, keep to one query every few seconds, and treat Overpass as scarce rather than looping over it. Nominatim took the same pace without complaint once a User-Agent was set.

reliwiki.nl.behaviour: hangs past the TCP/TLS connect, no response at all (curl -m 20 -A browser-UA, exit 28 both times)
reliwiki.nl.cost: two attempts during a Nijmegen deepen verify pass (candidate church page reliwiki.nl/index.php/Nijmegen,_Dennenstraat_125_-_Antonius_Abt), zero content returned
reliwiki.nl.workaround: unknown this pass; the Rijksmonument description at kennis.cultureelerfgoed.nl and the parish's own history page at mariakapelvinden.nl both loaded fine and covered the same church

services.nijmegen.nl.behaviour: TLS handshake completes, then hangs with no HTTP response (curl -m 20, exit 28 on a plain GetFeature request and exit 2 on a count-limited retry, both burning the full 20s)
services.nijmegen.nl.cost: two attempts trying to reach the municipality's own monumental-tree WFS layer (typeName extern_kaartviewer_GRN_BOMEN_MON) during a Nijmegen deepen verify pass, which would have been a genuinely independent second source distinct from the national LRMB register
services.nijmegen.nl.workaround: unknown this pass; opendata.nijmegen.nl's dataset landing page (opendata.nijmegen.nl/dataset/geoserver-bomen-nijmegen) itself was not tried directly and may serve a static CSV export instead of the live WFS endpoint, worth trying first next time
